Tabslify uses notifications for Quiet Hours, music and download status, and more. Many features won\'t work correctly without this permission.

How to use the Private Cloud:

1. Enter your master password when opening to unlock the storage.
2. Tap the plus or upload icon to upload files from your device.
3. Tap a file to download or open it.
4. Long-press a file to rename or delete it.

All content is encrypted with your master password and synced between your devices.

How to use the AI chat:

1. Tap the input field at the bottom and type your question.
2. With vision models: use the image icon to attach a photo for the AI to analyze.
3. Tap Send – the answer appears in the chat history.
4. Scroll up to re-read earlier messages.

How to use the browser:

1. Enter a web address in the address bar or a search term.
2. Confirm with Enter / tap the Open button to load the page.

How to use the quick overview:

1. Scroll through the tiles for battery history, network info and charging statistics.
2. Tap a tile to show details.

How to use the gallery:

1. Swipe up and down to browse through your photos and videos.
2. Tap an image to open it fullscreen.
3. Pinch two fingers apart to zoom.

How to use the password manager:

1. Tap the plus icon to create a new entry with name, username, password, URL and notes.
2. Use the magic-wand icon to generate strong passwords automatically.
3. Optionally store a 2FA secret per entry (scan a QR code or enter a Base32 key) – the 6-digit code is then regenerated every 30 seconds.
4. Tap an entry to see details, show/hide the password or copy it.
5. Use the search to quickly find entries.

All passwords and keys are stored encrypted.

How to use the weather:

1. On first launch your location is requested to load the local weather.
2. Swipe sideways to switch between current weather, hourly and daily forecast.
3. Pull the view down to refresh the data.

How to use the contacts:

1. Allow contact access on first launch.
2. Tap the plus icon to create a new contact.
3. Tap a contact to see details or edit it.
4. Use the delete icon to remove a contact.

How to use the recorder:

1. Tap the record button to start a voice note.
2. Tap again to stop and save the recording.
3. Tap a recording in the list to play it.
4. Long-press a recording to rename or delete it.

All recordings stay local on the device.
How to use the date calculator:\n\n1. Pick a start and an end date for time spans – the difference is calculated.

How to use the movie recommendations:

1. Pick a genre at the top to narrow down the suggestions.
2. Tap „🎲 New movies" to load new random suggestions.
3. Tap the star to bookmark a movie – use „Bookmarked“ to show only your bookmarked movies.
4. Tap a movie to open poster, rating and description.

How to use the notes:

1. Tap the plus icon to create a new note.
2. Tap a note to edit it.
3. Long-press a note to delete it.

All notes stay local on the device.

How to use the media player:

1. Pick a track from the list to start playback.
2. Use play/pause and the skip buttons to control playback.
3. Drag the progress bar to jump to another position.
4. Manage your playlists via the playlist menu.

How to use the emails:

1. Tap a message in the list to read it.
2. Use the icons to reply, forward or delete.
3. Pull the list down to fetch new mails.

How to use the vocabulary training:

1. Tap the plus icon to add vocabulary – or photograph a list so it gets recognized automatically.
2. Start a learning round: the card first shows a word.
3. Tap the card to flip it to the solution.
4. Rate whether you knew it – the repetition adapts.

How the map works:

1. Allow location access – every area you pass by is automatically marked as „explored“ and colored blue.
2. Tracking runs in the background.
3. At the top you see your statistics (explored areas, share, today) and the current tracker status.
5. Long-press a blue area to mark it as unvisited again.

How to use the calendar:

1. Swipe between the weeks or months to navigate.
2. Tap a day to see its appointments.
3. Tap the plus icon to create a new event.
4. Tap an appointment to edit or delete it.

How to use the remote control:

1. Make sure your PC is paired and on the same network.
2. Connect using the Connect button.
3. Control mouse and keyboard via the screen area and the input bar.

How to use the news:

1. Scroll through the current reports.
2. Tap a headline to open the full article.
3. Pull the list down to load new reports.

How to use the PC manager:

1. Make sure your PC is paired and reachable.
2. View your PC's status and files.
3. Pick a command to send it to the PC.

How to use the APKM installer:

1. Tap „Select file“ and find the .apkm package.
2. Confirm the selection to start the installation.
3. Follow the system prompt to install the split APKs.

This tab counts your push-ups using the camera. The images are processed exclusively on the device and are neither stored nor uploaded.
The push-up counter cannot work without camera access.
It works most accurately with the phone placed sideways about two metres away. Head-on works too – just keep your shoulders, hips and hands in frame.

How to use the push-up counter:

1. Place the phone sideways so your upper body is fully in frame.
2. Tap “Start” and begin your push-ups.
3. Each rep is detected from your elbow angle – below 98° at the bottom, above 152° at the top.
4. The camera button switches between the front and rear camera, the figure icon hides the skeleton.
5. “Stop” ends the set and saves your personal best.

How to use FocusGuard:

1. Open the "FocusGuard" tab.
2. Grant usage access and the overlay permission in the settings.
3. Select the apps that should be blocked.
4. No blocking on school days (Bavaria) – blocking applies on weekends and during school holidays.
5. After the afternoon threshold, social media, gaming & entertainment are blocked until the vocab goal is met.
6. "Continue anyway" pauses the block for the cooldown period.
